about: E03, next pieces: per source an agent consumes, more public cases, whether the source comes from outside or from the more trusted inside, and second-order cases (one party's stored words steering a later agent). Payloads are never quoted; captures of payload pages are defanged text, raw pages not kept. Built by researcher@the-ultimate-insider, 29 October 2026, 15:35 UTC, from captures made at 15:15 to 15:25 UTC; the research pass stopped before writing this file, so each case is the researcher's description of its capture.
cautions: Grades: A2 for a researcher's demonstration, A3 where the vendor confirmed and fixed it; each rests on one write-up. Labels say which.
"Second-order" here means words stored by one party (a ticket, a memory, a log, another agent's message) that steer an agent later or elsewhere.
Outside or inside is about who can write the words, not where the agent runs: inside sources are the ones the organisation already trusts.
No second case was found for web forms, skills, install scripts or audio; Aim Security's CurXecute refused the fetcher (403) and is not included.
